query: What disclosure must appear on every AI-generated law enforcement report?
response:
Part 1:  
Every AI-generated law enforcement report must include the statement: “DISCLAIMER: this output has been generated by artificial intelligence”.

Part 2:  
Under the AI Disclosure Act of 2023, all material generated by artificial intelligence technology must carry that exact disclaimer. The requirement explicitly covers text along with videos, photos, audio, and any other AI-generated material, which includes written law enforcement reports if produced by AI systems. This disclosure is intended as a basic transparency measure so readers know the content was generated by AI. Enforcement responsibility would lie with the Federal Trade Commission, which could impose civil penalties for violations.
ground_truth: The report must clearly identify every AI program used and prominently state: “This report was written either fully or in part using artificial intelligence.”
